title: 3 Parkdale Place, Point Cook, Vic 3030 - House for Sale - realestate.com.au
ogDescription:
Ace Real Estate proudly presents 3 Parkdale place , Point Cook. Perfectly positioned in the prestigious Alamanda Estate, 3 Parkdale Place enjoys an exceptional location directly opposite Party Place BBQ Area and Palmtree Place Park. Set on a substantial 578m² (approx.) north-facing allotment, this beautifully presented home combines grand proportions, quality finishes and a thoughtfully designed floorplan ideal for modern family living.

Located within Alamanda Estate itself and zoned to the highly sought-after Alamanda K-9 College, this is an outstanding opportunity to secure a luxurious Metricon Prestige home in a premium family-oriented neighbourhood.
From the moment you arrive, the majestic façade and beautifully landscaped front garden create an impressive first impression.

Step inside and be welcomed by soaring 2.7-metre ceilings, elegant interiors and multiple living zones designed to provide both space and flexibility.

The expansive formal lounge, positioned to the left as you enter, provides an impressive setting for entertaining guests or enjoying quiet family time.

At the heart of the home is the gorgeous designer kitchen, featuring overhead cabinetry, a feature bulkhead, 900mm freestanding gas cooktop and dishwasher. The kitchen enjoys a seamless connection to the spacious meals and family area, creating a wonderful central hub for everyday living.

Large doors open from the family area to an enormous undercover alfresco, overlooking the beautifully maintained backyard - perfect for entertaining, family gatherings and relaxed outdoor living.

Luxurious Master Suite

Privately positioned on the right-hand side as you enter, the impressive master bedroom provides a peaceful parents'
retreat and features:
• Full ensuite
• Twin vanities
• Fully fitted walk-in robe
• Generous bedroom proportions

Family Accommodation

The remaining three bedrooms are generously proportioned and equipped with built-in robes, sharing a beautifully appointed central bathroom and separate toilet.
A dedicated retreat positioned between the three bedrooms provides an additional living space that can be utilised as a children's lounge, study zone, gaming area or quiet retreat.

Features You'll Love

• 4 spacious bedrooms
• 2 bathrooms
• Additional powder room
• 2-car garage
• 578m² (approx.) north-facing allotment
• Metricon Prestige home
• 2.7m high ceilings
• Expansive formal lounge
• Spacious informal family and meals area
• Additional bedroom retreat
• Gorgeous kitchen with overhead cabinetry and feature bulkhead
• 900mm freestanding gas cooktop
• Dishwasher
• Plantation shutters to all openable windows
• Spacious laundry
• Ducted heating
• Evaporative cooling
• Huge undercover alfresco
• Beautifully landscaped front and rear gardens
• Majestic façade
• Multiple living zones

The Alamanda Lifestyle

Location is where this home truly excels.
Enjoy the convenience of having Palmtree Place Park and the Party Place BBQ area directly opposite, providing easy access to beautiful open spaces and family-friendly recreational facilities.
Families will appreciate being zoned to Alamanda K-9 College, while the broader Alamanda Estate lifestyle offers a fantastic combination of parks, schools, recreational facilities and everyday conveniences.

3 Parkdale Place, Point Cook is a rare opportunity to secure a substantial, luxurious Metricon Prestige home on approximately 578m², offering the perfect balance of elegance, space, functionality and location.
A prestigious address. A magnificent home. An exceptional lifestyle.

Inspection is highly recommended - experience the quality and grandeur of this exceptional Alamanda residence for yourself.

title: 10 Snowsill Circuit, Point Cook, Vic 3030 - House for Sale - realestate.com.au
ogDescription:
Welcome to this beautifully presented four-bedroom home, perfectly suited for families seeking comfort, space and easy living. From the moment you step inside, the warmth and practicality of this home are sure to impress.

Featuring stylish walnut-look floorboards throughout the main living areas, the home offers a modern and welcoming feel. The master bedroom is privately positioned at the front of the home, complete with convenient access to the ensuite with double vanity- extended shower and walk-in robe.

At the heart of the home is a spacious open-plan living and dining area, filled with an abundance of natural light and designed for everyday family living and entertaining.

The modern kitchen is sure to impress, featuring 900mm stainless-steel appliances, a generous island with stone benchtop and a walk-in butler's pantry, providing plenty of storage and preparation space.

The home also offers a large laundry, complete with a linen cupboard, laundry sink and direct external access for added convenience.

Comfort is assured year-round with zoned refrigerated cooling, additional split-system air conditioning, ceiling fans and ducted heating, while the thoughtful layout provides plenty of natural light throughout the home.

Step outside to discover a generous backyard, complete with a beautiful pergola featuring walnut decking, creating the perfect space for entertaining family and friends. There is also plenty of room for the kids or pets to enjoy, along with a garden shed for additional storage.

Property Features:
- 4 bigger than standard bedrooms
- 2 bathrooms
- Double garage
- Master bedroom positioned at the front of the home
- Walnut-look floorboards
- Light-filled open-plan living and dining area
- Modern kitchen with 900mm stainless-steel appliances
- Stone Island benchtops
- Walk-in butler's pantry
- Large laundry with linen storage and sink
- External laundry access
- Ducted heating and Refrigerated cooling with additional Split-system air conditioning and ceiling fans
- Large backyard
- Covered entertaining pergola with walnut decking

Easy access to freeway and upcoming Aldi. Walking distance from the nearest bus stop and parks including the Webster oval.

A wonderful opportunity to secure a comfortable and well-appointed family home in Point Cook - this is one you won't want to miss!

title: 23 Ambassador Crescent, Point Cook, Vic 3030 - House for Sale - realestate.com.au
ogDescription:
There’s something special about a home that gives everyone their own space, yet still brings the family together where it matters most. At 23 Ambassador, generous living zones, inviting outdoor spaces and a thoughtfully designed floorplan create a home that feels made for the rhythm of everyday family life.

Step inside and the front living room offers an immediate sense of separation, with high ceilings adding to the home’s sense of space. Perfect for quiet evenings, welcoming guests or simply escaping with a book. Further in, the home opens into its true heart, where the kitchen, dining and living areas come together in one warm and social space.

The stone island kitchen sits naturally at the centre, giving family and friends somewhere to gather while dinner is being prepared. Complete with 900mm gas appliances and a walk-in pantry, it’s a kitchen designed for everything from busy weekday mornings to long dinners shared around the table.

When the weather warms, open the doors and carry life outside to the decked alfresco. Whether it’s a relaxed Sunday breakfast, drinks with friends or watching the kids enjoy the backyard, the landscaped surrounds offer an inviting outdoor setting without demanding your weekends in return. Secure side access and rear access through the double garage add another layer of everyday practicality.

Upstairs becomes its own family retreat. A central rumpus gives children and teenagers a space to call their own, while the master suite offers something just for you. Step onto your private balcony for a quiet moment at the beginning or end of the day, then retreat inside to a walk-in robe and private ensuite with dual basins.

Three further bedrooms with built-in robes and the main family bathroom complete the upper level, while ducted heating, evaporative cooling and downlighting ensure comfort across the seasons.

With multiple places to relax, room to entertain and outdoor living that’s wonderfully easy to enjoy, 23 Ambassador is a home where family life has space to grow.

Key Features

* Four-bedroom family layout with multiple living zones
* High ceilings
* Private master retreat with balcony, WIR and dual-basin ensuite
* Stone island kitchen with 900mm gas appliances and walk-in pantry
* Open-plan living and dining flowing to the decked alfresco
* Landscaped, low-maintenance backyard
* Separate front living room plus upstairs rumpus
* Double garage with rear access and secure side access to backyard
* Ducted heating and evaporative cooling
* Downstairs powder room and separate laundry with side access
* West-facing frontage

title: 57 Bondi Parade, Point Cook, Vic 3030 - House for Sale - realestate.com.au
ogDescription:
Positioned in the highly sought-after Saltwater Coast Estate and set on an approximate 385m² allotment, this beautifully designed family residence combines generous proportions, multiple living zones and a lifestyle location that is second to none. Enjoy serene estuary outlooks while being moments from local amenities and exclusive resident facilities.

Upstairs, the home offers four spacious bedrooms, thoughtfully designed for family comfort. The master suite is a true retreat, featuring a walk in robe, fully fitted ensuite and private balcony capturing peaceful views. The remaining three bedrooms are all fitted with built in robes and are serviced by a central family bathroom complete with separate shower and bath—ideal for busy family living or relaxed unwinding.

A versatile upper-level retreat provides an additional living space, perfectly suited as a second lounge, kids’ zone or study area, adding valuable flexibility to the floorplan.

Downstairs, the heart of the home showcases a well-appointed kitchen featuring an extended stone benchtop, 900mm gas cooktop, ample cabinetry, double-door pantry and double sink. Designed with everyday functionality in mind, it flows seamlessly into the open-plan dining and living zones, which extend effortlessly to the outdoor entertaining area and spacious backyard.

The backyard offers an excellent blank canvas—generous in size and ideal for children, pets, or those looking to add their own landscaping vision and personal touch.

Comfort is assured year-round with ducted heating and evaporative cooling, while additional features such as a downstairs powder room and internal access from the double remote garage enhance everyday convenience and security.

Features Include:

- Four large bedrooms, master with ensuite, walk in robe and private balcony
- Upstairs retreat with potential study space
- Two separate living zones
- Central family bathroom with bath and separate shower
- Downstairs powder room
- Kitchen with stone benchtops, 900mm gas cooktop and double pantry
- Open-plan living and dining flowing to outdoor area
- Ducted heating and evaporative cooling
- Double remote garage with internal access
- Spacious backyard ready to personalise
- Access to Saltwater Coast Lifestyle Centre facilities

Perfectly located within close proximity to local shopping precincts, quality primary and secondary schools, parklands and walking tracks, and with exclusive access to the Saltwater Coast Lifestyle Centre, this home delivers the complete family lifestyle package.

A rare opportunity to secure a spacious, well-designed home in one of Point Cook’s most desirable communities.

From all of us at P Di Natale Real Estate, we wish you every success in your search for your new home. If you would like more detail on this property or to discuss one of the other properties we have available, please do not hesitate to call or email us.

With multiple living areas, an oversized master suite and a substantial backyard, this is a home with plenty to offer now and into the future.

ogDescription:
This is your exquisite opportunity to secure a stunning 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom family home situated in the heart of the popular Featherbrook Estate. The beautifully designed house with high ceilings offers a perfect blend of style, comfort, and functionality, making it an ideal choice for families looking for their dream home.

Boasting 3 spacious living areas, including a formal lounge and a family room overlooking the leafy Point Cook Creek, this property provides ample space for relaxation and entertainment. The well-appointed kitchen features modern appliances and ample storage, making it a delight for those who love to cook and entertain.

With a double garage, an additional powder room, a separate laundry room, and a generous outdoor area, this home offers convenience and space for the whole family to enjoy. Don't miss this opportunity to own a contemporary family home in one of Point Cook's most desirable locations.

So close to Boardwalk Boulevard and the Sneydes Road freeway interchange, walk to Featherbrook Shopping Centre, Featherbrook Reserve, Featherbrook College, Featherbrook Community Centre, and bus transport to Williams Landing trains.

Homes of this size, quality, and location are rare to come by. Contact us today to arrange a viewing and make this property your own!
